notes.title: Bug Fix - Good Pistol
notes.notes: The bonus to combat for finding the good pistol was not being activated as expected.  This has been fixed now.

notes.title: Minor Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes:

 The health numbers on your character sheet were not updating as expected alongside the health boxes when you used medical supplies.  This has been corrected.
 Page 655 – the herbalist's herb shop – had a picture when it shouldn't to aid readability of the text.  The image has been removed.
